marketplace.name: acb
marketplace.description: Reviewed context for Claude Code: every plugin has a REVIEW.md and evals

session_model._: The typical session the «Token cost» column is measured against: turns model calls, each with context_tokens of input and output_tokens of output. Δ% = (standing cost × turns + per-call cost × calls + behavioural effect) / (turns × (context + output)). MCP: if the tool schemas exceed mcp_defer_over_tokens, Claude Code loads them deferred and only the names stay in context (mcp_deferred_tokens_per_tool per tool).

must-have.label: Must have
must-have.hint: into any project by default: almost always pays off, no conditions

stack.label: For the stack
stack.hint: if the project uses the technology or service from the description

task.label: For a task
task.hint: for the duration of a specific job, then remove; usually expensive on activation

taste.label: Taste
taste.hint: a person's working style, not the project's; install into ~/.claude

no.label: Don't install
no.hint: rejected by the reviewer; the entry stays as a warning
